# viettelcloud_db_instance (Data Source)

Find one Viettel Cloud DBaaS DB instance by ID or exact name. Configure exactly one of id and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_db_instance" "example" {
  name = "example-db"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) DB instance ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Exact DB instance name, unique in the project.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) CIDRs allowed to connect.
- `auto_increase_volume_size` (Attributes) Automatic disk increase. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_increase_volume_size))
- `backup_policy` (Attributes) Automatic backup policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_policy))
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `current_disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GB that the backend has provisioned, including any automatic increase.
- `database_type` (String) Database type.
- `db_version` (String) DB version.
- `db_version_id` (String) DB version ID (UUID).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disk_full` (Boolean) Whether the disk is full.
- `enable_public_access` (Boolean) Whether the instance has a public endpoint.
- `enable_ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled.
- `error_message` (String) Last error that the backend reported.
- `flavor` (String) Flavor name.
- `flavor_id` (String) Flavor ID (UUID).
- `flavor_ram` (Number) RAM of the flavor in MB.
- `flavor_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of the flavor.
- `init_backup_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the backup that the instance was restored from, if any.
- `keep_backup` (Boolean) Whether backups remain after the instance is deleted.
- `maintenance_config` (Attributes) Maintenance window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_config))
- `operational_status` (String) Running operation.
- `port` (Number) Database port.
- `private_url` (String) Private endpoint host.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `public_url` (String) Public endpoint host.
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `solution` (String) Solution.
- `status` (String) Instance status.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) Subnet CIDR.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID (UUID).
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `used_disk_size` (Number) Used disk space in MB.
- `volume_type` (String) Volume type name.
- `volume_type_disk_type` (String) Disk type of the volume type.
- `volume_type_id` (String) Volume type ID (UUID).
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) of the subnet.
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name of the subnet.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_increase_volume_size"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_increase_volume_size`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the disk grows automatically.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum disk size in GB.
- `threshold` (Number) Used-space percentage that triggers an increase.


<a id="nestedatt--backup_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_policy`

Read-Only:

- `backup_interval` (String) daily or weekly.
- `day_of_week` (String) Lowercase day name of a weekly backup.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic backups run.
- `max_auto_backup` (Number) Automatic backups kept.
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour, 0 to 23.


<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_config`

Read-Only:

- `day_of_week` (String) Lowercase day name.
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour, 0 to 23.
